sources.entry: Seewo EasiNote - Interactive courseware tool for teachers. #free

summary.name: Seewo EasiNote
summary.one_liner: 希沃白板5 (Seewo EasiNote 5) is an interactive courseware tool for teachers to prepare and deliver lessons with multimedia, tools, and classroom activities.
use_cases: control slides from a phone during class
show student work on the big screen
share and receive courseware across devices
run classroom activities with built-in tools
summary.what_it_does: The page describes Seewo EasiNote 5 as a courseware tool built for teaching scenarios, with cloud courseware sync, subject tools, mind maps, classroom activities and a "super classification" feature. Basic tools include multiple tools and animations, plus subject resources, classroom activities and cloud storage. Phones and computers signed into the same account can run dual-screen sync, where the phone flips slides or shows annotations on the large screen. A phone camera can upload photos or livestream student work to the display. Courseware can be shown on computers, interactive panels, web pages and phones, and shared with one-click send and receive.
notable: Phone-to-big-screen control with dual-screen sync and annotation
Cloud courseware sync and one-click courseware sharing
Subject resources, classroom activity tools and mind maps
Mobile app lets phone camera upload or livestream student work
caveats: macOS version requires OS X 10.15 or later and supports Intel and Apple chips
iOS app requires iOS 13.0 or later; Android app requires Android 6.0 or later
Pricing and membership tiers are not detailed on the page; a membership system is mentioned in navigation only
